data.narrative:
Strider Technologies is a Series C-stage defense and security company that has raised $117M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 12 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies, comprising 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Quantum-Systems, Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $117M total raised as a proxy base value and applying a 1.7x multiplier typical of Series C-to-next-stage advancement, implies a valuation of $199M. The peer-median approach references 12 same-sector peers spanning Series B through Series D, with individual valuations ranging from $300M (floor) to $18.0B (Helsing at Series D). The median across this set is $2.3B, substantially higher than the stage-progression result but grounded in observable transactions in the Defense & Security sector.

The two methods produce a wide implied range. The triangulated median valuation of $1.3B sits between the stage-progression floor of $169M and the peer-median ceiling of $2.7B. This dispersion reflects genuine uncertainty: stage-progression relies on raised capital as a proxy absent actual revenue or profitability data, while the peer set exhibits wide heterogeneity across both stage and presumably operational maturity. Key unknowns include Strider's revenue run rate, customer concentration, and whether its technology footprint and go-to-market traction track more closely to earlier-stage or advanced-stage peers.
